title: Virtual Compute: snapshot allocation — backup entitlement
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute snapshot allocation — For a shared snapshot source retained throughout a complete UTC service month, read backup plan entitlement in GB from the unique same-entity active backup holding as the GB-month entitlement to allocate; absent matching backup gives zero entitlement.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for snapshot allocation — backup entitlement?**

For a shared snapshot source retained throughout a complete UTC service month, read backup plan entitlement in GB from the unique same-entity active backup holding as the GB-month entitlement to allocate; absent matching backup gives zero entitlement.

## Contract reference authority

Use the active same-entity managed-backup contract entitlement or tier pricing numerically; all resulting records remain compute-managed.
